SELECT
ROUND(AVG(overall_rating),1) AS overallRating,
COUNT(*) AS reviewCount,
ROUND(AVG(career_growth_rating),1) AS careerGrowthRating,
ROUND(AVG(work_satisfaction_rating),1) AS workSatisfactionRating,
ROUND(AVG(compensation_rating),1) AS compensationRating,
ROUND(AVG(culture_rating),1) AS cultureRating,
SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating5Count, SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating4Count, SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating3Count, SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating2Count, SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating1Count
FROM company_reviews
WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status='정상'

SELECT cr.company_review_id, cr.company_id, cr.author_user_id, cr.eligibility_application_id,
cr.employment_status, cr.job_category_id, jc.category_name AS jobCategoryName,
cr.career_growth_rating, cr.work_satisfaction_rating, cr.compensation_rating, cr.culture_rating,
cr.overall_rating,
cr.pros, cr.cons, cr.summary,
cr.status,
cr.hidden_reason, cr.hidden_by,
cr.help_count,
cr.created_at, cr.updated_at
FROM company_reviews cr
LEFT JOIN job_categories jc ON cr.job_category_id = jc.job_category_id
WHERE cr.company_id = #{companyId} AND cr.status = '정상'
ORDER BY cr.help_count DESC, cr.created_at DESC
ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM company_reviews
WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status='정상'

SELECT
COUNT(*) AS reviewCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN ir.interview_result = '합격' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.interview_result = '불합격' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.interview_result = '대기' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitingCount,
ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN ir.interview_result = '합격' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0 ) AS passPercent,
ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN ir.interview_result = '불합격' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0 ) AS failPercent,
ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN ir.interview_result = '대기' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0 ) AS waitingPercent,
( SELECT difficulty FROM interview_reviews WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status = '정상' GROUP BY difficulty ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS difficulty,
MAX(jp.process_text) AS processText
FROM interview_reviews ir
LEFT JOIN job_postings jp ON ir.job_posting_id = jp.job_posting_id
WHERE ir.company_id = #{companyId} AND ir.status = '정상'

SELECT
ir.interview_review_id, ir.company_id, ir.author_user_id, ir.job_posting_id, ir.application_id,
ir.interview_month, ir.interview_type, ir.interview_result, ir.difficulty,
ir.process_text,
ir.content, ir.tips,
ir.status,
ir.hidden_reason, ir.hidden_by,
ir.help_count,
ir.created_at, ir.updated_at,
jp.title, jp.career_type
FROM interview_reviews ir
LEFT JOIN job_postings jp ON ir.job_posting_id = jp.job_posting_id
WHERE ir.company_id = #{companyId} AND ir.status = '정상'
ORDER BY ir.help_count DESC, ir.created_at DESC
ORDER BY ir.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM interview_reviews
WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status = '정상'
